en: Black‑and‑white historic street scene showing a wide cobblestone avenue flanked by ornate late‑19th‑century townhouses or civic buildings. People in early 20th‑century European clothing (women in long dresses, men in caps and uniforms, children with toys) walk and stand along the sidewalks and by wrought‑iron fences. The architecture features stucco and brick façades, pilasters, arched windows, and mansard roofs. A gentle rise in the distance suggests the street climbs a hill lined with similar buildings. There are telegraph poles and gas or early electric streetlights. On the right side, a hanging sign projects from a building façade.
